Stadium shell
Wraps one continuous roof round the whole ground, on raked columns. While it is on, the roofs and outer facades on the individual stands are hidden. Switch it on, then choose the roof, skin and colours.

Your Ground Details

Camera angle

Classic is the corner-on isometric view. Angled turns the camera 30° so it looks more squarely down the pitch at the far stand; use the ground view buttons to look from any side. Lower tilts the camera towards pitch level, so the stands stand taller and the ground looks flatter.
